title: Judging a Fact: Resulta inadmisible que…
goal: Judge a known fact with the subjunctive after resulta inadmisible que, es de lamentar que and el hecho de que, and tell a judgment from a statement of evidence.

items: I can judge a fact with *Resulta inadmisible que…* and *Es de lamentar que…* and the subjunctive.
I can use *el hecho de que* + subjunctive to comment on a fact we both know.
I can tell a judgment (subjunctive) from a statement of evidence (*Resulta evidente que* + indicative).
